headwords: đói cho sạch, rách cho thơm

flags.why: The example unnaturally treats đòi cơn as an adjective modifying pain, whereas its attested use means repeatedly, as in sụt sùi đòi cơn ([linguistic study](https://vjol.info.vn/index.php/VSS/article/download/32719/27821/)).
flags.fix: Nàng sụt sùi đòi cơn. = She sobbed repeatedly.

flags.why: This expression is mainly Southern but lacks a regional tag ([usage description](https://phunumoi.net.vn/ngon-ngu-mien-tay-premium-gay-sot-cung-o-viet-nam-ma-nghe-xong-phai-di-tra-google-lien-d333060.html)).
The example explains the letter name instead of using it in context.
flags.fix: Mã này bắt đầu bằng đúp lờ vê. = This code starts with W.
